full_page.content:
Page 28 Cont.
Mar. 5 Nick Schorn
Ralph Raymond Campick - 4week - no throat muscles.
Page 29
Mar. Miss Jeanette Herson - PL-6993 - 4224 Mcclellan
Mar. 10 Bernard Stano - 7 - lost one eye in July 1942 - now Dr's fear necessity of taking the other, which of course would mean total blindness is enrolled in Ser. Masses.
Louise Polsinelli - 36 - had goiter removed four yrs. ago. Now seems coming back ....
12 Mrs. Frances Senstock - 62 - in Providence Hosp., a canundrum to Dr's. X-rays show nothing. They want to operate and that way find the secret of her very critical condition. So far husband has re- fused consent. Enrolled To-day in Ser. Masses 5.
12 Mrs. Anna Matuzeski - 78 - ailing for years - fell seven weeks ago and is in bed ever since ... cancer now appearing in threatening places - enrolled in Ser. Masses Today 5.
Page 30
Mar. 13 John W. Armaly - daily Com. of late. .. . Family, Wife - 38 - restless - has been receiving Holy Communion annually.
13 Eleanor Hohns - 26 - Lutherans - enrolled March (7) last Wed. for Hodgkins disease. Parents were very much discouraged. - Father returns To-day with report that daughter is better - even gone back to work - Deo Gr.
Joseph Jolly - 54 - very peculiar pains in limbs.
John Friedman - 10- brain - tumor
14 Doris Sisiak - 17 - something like a stroke Dr's rather fear sleeping sickness.
Miss Eva S. Minock - 71 - very threatening groth on side of neck - enrolled.
